description: Use for "who is buying?", "which placement works best?" or "is my custom audience big enough?". Returns buyers in the period, saved custom audiences with size and whether each is big enough to deliver, and results split by placement (Instagram, Facebook, Reels, Stories). For overall ROAS use get_performance; for funnel drop offs use get_sales_funnel. Saved data from the latest Meta read.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.

name: get_audiences
